claude_proposed_widenings.name: companion_creation_spell_family
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Create Undead is instantaneous but its purpose is producing persistent autonomous companions. No existing spell family captures this: activation requires attack_roll/save_gate phases with damage/none effects; ongoing_effect requires concentration with a roll or damage operation; anchored_trigger requires a planted location-bound release. A new family is needed whose activation produces create_companion atoms and links to an ongoing command_companion protocol.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Each one becomes a Ghoul under your control... As a Bonus Action on each of your turns, you can mentally command any creature you animated with this spell if the creature is within 120 feet of you

claude_proposed_widenings.name: companion_creation_effect
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The Effect type (DamageEffect | NoneEffect) has no variant for creating a companion creature. The v4 atom 'create_companion' exists in the taxonomy but has no surface expression in any spell Effect type.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Choose up to three corpses of Medium or Small Humanoids within range. Each one becomes a Ghoul under your control

claude_proposed_widenings.name: companion_command_operation
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The ongoing Bonus Action command loop — mentally directing animated creatures each turn within 120 ft — is a persistent per-turn operation not captured by OngoingOperation (roll_modifier | damage_on_hit). The v4 atom 'command_companion' exists but has no surface expression.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: As a Bonus Action on each of your turns, you can mentally command any creature you animated with this spell if the creature is within 120 feet of you

claude_proposed_widenings.name: control_duration_with_recast_maintenance
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The 24-hour control window that expires unless the caster recasts the spell on the same creature is a novel lifecycle pattern. The existing lifecycle atoms (concentrate, persist, expire, dismiss) don't capture 'expires unless refreshed by recasting this specific spell before deadline'. The recast mode (reasserts rather than animates) is also new.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The creature is under your control for 24 hours, after which it stops obeying any command you've given it. To maintain control... you must cast this spell on the creature before the current 24-hour period ends. This use of the spell reasserts your control over up to three creatures you have animated with this spell rather than animating new ones.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: time_of_day_precondition
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The night-only casting restriction ('You can cast this spell only at night') is a precondition on the cast itself that has no surface representation. No existing CastingTime variant or surface type captures a time-of-day gate.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You can cast this spell only at night.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: slot_scaled_creature_type_substitution
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Higher-level upcasting for Create Undead does not just scale a count — it substitutes creature types at different slot thresholds (Slot 8: 5 Ghouls OR 2 Ghasts/Wights; Slot 9: 6 Ghouls OR 3 Ghasts/Wights OR 2 Mummies). Existing SlotScaling<T> handles numeric quantity scaling only. A named-creature-type selection under slot-level thresholds requires a new surface shape.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: If you use a level 8 spell slot, you can animate or reassert control over five Ghouls or two Ghasts or Wights. If you use a level 9 spell slot, you can animate or reassert control over six Ghouls, three Ghasts or Wights, or two Mummies.
